title: What's New: Key Updates in our Learning Content (documentation) For Developers (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: New Developer Documentation Overview and AKA Link
Documentation Structure: Getting Started and AL Programming
Data Analytics and Reporting for Developers
Reporting Documentation: Reports and Word Layouts
Background Processing and Telemetry for Developers
Contributing to Documentation and Getting Started

features.name: New Developer Documentation Overview
features.description: A new AKA link aka.ms/BC developer that centralizes developer documentation, including getting started, AL language programming, data analytics, reporting, error handling, troubleshooting, background processing, telemetry, security, and extensibility sections.

features.name: Data Analytics for Developers
features.description: A new documentation section explaining different analytics artifacts available to developers including queries, data analysis on lists, Power BI reports, and Excel layouts to help customers think about analytics differently.

features.name: Reporting Documentation Overhaul
features.description: Comprehensive rewrite of reporting documentation covering everything needed for developing reports, with expanded coverage of report types and best practices.

features.name: Word Layouts Documentation
features.description: New comprehensive documentation on word layouts for document reporting, covering how to design datasets that work well with word layouts, layout design, and transition from RDL to word layout world.
caveats: Helps transition from RDL to word layouts particularly for document reports

features.name: Error Handling Documentation
features.description: New documentation section on error handling including reasoning about errors, failure modeling, robust coding practices, understanding error dialogs and stack traces, actionable errors, and meaningful error messages.

features.name: Troubleshooting Guides and Tools
features.description: New troubleshooting overview documentation providing indication of different troubleshooting tools available and troubleshooting guides (TSGs) in many different areas.

features.name: Background Processing Documentation
features.description: New overview documentation on running things in the background to improve perceived performance, covering session pages, background tasks, task scheduler, job queue, and other asynchronous processing methods.

features.name: Telemetry for AL Developers
features.description: Enhanced telemetry documentation for AL developers including new content on telemetry scope and visibility to the feature telemetry module in system application for free telemetry features.

features.name: Security for Developers
features.description: New documentation section on business central security for developers, covering how to reason about security in the development lifecycle and topics needed to deliver secure apps.

features.name: Extensibility Overview Documentation
features.description: New extensibility overview documentation covering ways to extend in AL, extend through system application or base app changes, client extensions, Power BI extensions, and all ways to extend business central.

features.name: Documentation Contribution Process
features.description: Documentation and guidance on how developers can contribute to business central documentation through GitHub pull requests, with a contribute search in docs to get started.
